name: integralClosure.mem_lifts_of_monic_of_dvd_map
statement: R[X]} (hf : f.Monic) {g : K[X]} (hg : g.Monic) (hd : g ∣ f.map (algebraMap R K)) : g ∈ lifts (algebraMap (integralClosure R K) K)

name: IsIntegrallyClosed.eq_map_mul_C_of_dvd
statement: R[X]} (hf : f.Monic) {g : K[X]} (hg : g ∣ f.map (algebraMap R K)) : ∃ g' : R[X], g'.map (algebraMap R K) * (C <| leadingCoeff g) = g

have_tree.name: g_mul_dvd

name: IsPrimitive.mul_map_mem_lifts_iff
statement: R[X]} (hf : IsPrimitive f) {g : K[X]} : g * f.map (algebraMap R K) ∈ lifts (algebraMap R K) ↔ g ∈ lifts (algebraMap R K)

name: IsPrimitive.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map
statement: R[X]} (hp : p.IsPrimitive) : Irreducible p ↔ Irreducible (p.map (algebraMap R K))

name: IsPrimitive.dvd_of_fraction_map_dvd_fraction_map
statement: R[X]} (hp : p.IsPrimitive) (hq : q.IsPrimitive) (h_dvd : p.map (algebraMap R K) ∣ q.map (algebraMap R K)) : p ∣ q
